en.title: Write a welcome slip
en.statement: Write the output statement for a welcome slip. The input-reading setup is supplied. Read one complete line, then print Welcome, followed by one space and that line. Preserve spaces inside the name. The input always contains one line, possibly empty; its final newline is not part of the name. Do not print prompts or extra lines.
hints: Separate the fixed greeting from the name received on the input line.
Keep name outside the quoted greeting, so its stored text becomes part of the output.
Print the fixed text Welcome, with a space after the comma, joined to name.

python.starterCode:
name = input()
# Write the output statement below.

javascript.starterCode:
const name = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8").replace(/\r?\n$/, "");
// Write the output statement below.

typescript.starterCode:
const name: string = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8").replace(/\r?\n$/, "");
// Write the output statement below.
